method_identity: F2 own-method representation with Stage3 model, existing loss and prototype mechanism

cleaned_configuration.checkpoint_selection: highest harmonic mean of Known Validation Accuracy and Macro-F1
cleaned_configuration.prototype_reset_implementation: in-place copy; clear prototype Adam state; preserve optimizer parameter identity

cleanup_pass: both primary runs complete exactly 100 epochs without NaN or crash
weak primary Macro-F1 improves by at least 0.10 over original F2
normal primary Macro-F1 declines by no more than 0.03 from original F2
absolute seed sensitivity is lower than the corresponding Stage14C3 D0-vs-D6 difference for both protocols
decision_gate.partial_pass: under-training is removed and weak run improves, but one stability/non-degradation condition fails
decision_gate.needs_further_diagnosis: a primary run fails, under-training remains, or weak Macro-F1 improves by less than 0.10

forbidden: using native Open-Detect training code as the cleaned method
